scientific_integrity: Previous rational ranks and Alexander duality are credited to Conant and Thistlethwaite; first public date corresponds to v1, whereas the cited rational computation is in v2. No independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Integral homology, not complete homotopy type; possible nontrivial attaching maps of the critical seven-cells remain undetermined. The finite acyclicity assertion relies on complete deterministic replay.
title: Integral homology of the five-cube theta complex
